subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, the word ‘FAME’ is written as ‘IDPH’. The word ‘PINK’ is written as ‘SLQN’. How is the word ‘RUDE written in the same code language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

1) 'FAME' is written as 'IDPH'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/714e45d40c0868b050ad97e4d888d59e33680a0596769bf83233e9e9232bd6c1.png] 

And,

2) ‘PINK’ is written as ‘SLQN’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/243bfafe58d832515e4b2d6cdc7b0ab705c6ca8e5b6c2c32e880e2089073342b.png] 

Similarly,

3) 'RUDE' is written as ?

&
lt;img alt="" src="https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad332de584be6004a7d13085ac5328ecb49003806616ceae90ba8d4c76823125.png" style="width: 151px; height: 140px;" />

Hence, the correct answer is 'UXGH'.
